subject: Paired processing of data from different Affy platforms

messages.author: 9c09694062cb7736
messages.subject: Paired processing of data from different Affy platforms
parts:
Hi all,

I have tumour / normal data to analyze, with the wrinkle that the
normal samples were processed on Affy SNP 6 chips while the
tumour samples were processed on Affy 500K chips.

To do a paired analysis, I need to extract the probesets
from the Affy SNP6 chips that match the Affy 500K probesets,
then set up dummy files or objects in place of the SNP6
objects that are in the Affy 500K format, so I can then have
all samples appearing to come from Affy 500K.

Are there any tools in the aroma.affymetrix toolkit that
facilitate such a maneuvre, or are there other ways of
allowing paired processing of data obtained from different
Affy chip types?




Steven McKinney

Statistician
Molecular Oncology and Breast Cancer Program
British Columbia Cancer Research Centre
